author: Zintenka
body:
I am seeing a lot of CTW submissions and they're getting accepted.

My questions are:

When will CTW be implemented to the server? 

And will old maps that were CTWs revert back to their original form like Rendezvous?

title: CTW..?

replies.author: Dyspa
replies.body:
CTW will come in the server for the Winter Update with all the maps that have been accepted for the gamemode just named.

Regarding the old maps being turned into CTW maps, I'm not pretty sure so you'll have to wait for an answer coming out from a developer.
